$comment: Every repo of the IT-Kamianets 3D Engine and the Temnorid games. tools/setup.mjs clones a repo and, by reading its package.json / Packages/manifest.json, every repo it needs. `requires` lists links that are not Unity package dependencies (e.g. a package that implements a schema). `path` (optional, default: the name) is where the repo lives in the workspace. `org` (optional, default: the top-level `org`) is the GitHub organization it lives in. Keep this list current: tools/new-package.mjs adds new packages automatically.
